verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Facial Similarity reports comparing selfie/video to document portrait and explicit liveness via Motion (head turn/randomized head movements), which addresses replay/photo-of-photo type attacks. However, there is no documented detail on specific anti-spoofing defenses against printed photos, screen replay, or deepfake/video injection attacks, nor independent/hands-on validation of liveness robustness. missing for 10: explicit documentation of defenses against printed photos/screen replays/video injection, independent or third-party testing of liveness accuracy, anti-spoofing certification (e.g., iBeta/NIST) evidence.
